Two timelines diverge from this moment. Same planet, same technology, opposite destinies. The only variable is a 1% budget reallocation.

## Path A: Moronia

You continue on your current path. The ever-growing dark economy of cybercrime and AI-driven conflict draws the smartest minds. The singularity happens, but it's an inverse one, a hockey stick pointing straight down. Global systems collapse, antibiotics fail, and the average lifespan plummets. Warlords with AI armies fight over the scraps in a radioactive wasteland. Earth's final epitaph: "They had magic but chose madness."

![When your smartest people realize they can make more money hacking banks than curing cancer, your civilization is about to have a bad time. This is Path A. You're currently on it.](/assets/images/futures/futures-section-path-a-moronia-bw-academic.jpg)

## Path B: Wishonia

You pass a 1% treaty. The brightest minds and most powerful technologies shift from destruction to creation. The feedback loop is immediate: more funding leads to more cures, which leads to more public support for more funding. By 2040, aging is reversible, suffering is optional, and scarcity is a memory. By 2050, you have cured death, solved physics, and are planning your expansion into the galaxy.

![Spend money on cures, get cures, which saves money, which you spend on more cures. It's a vicious cycle of not dying. Path B is weirdly addictive once you start.](/assets/images/futures/futures-section-wishonia-timeline-loop-bw-academic.jpg)

## The Only Variable

Same species.
Same year.
Same technology.
The only difference: One 1% budget reallocation.

## The Two Paths

![Path A: Keep doing what you're doing, extinct by 2050. Path B: Try literally anything else, maybe don't die. Both options are on the table. You're remarkably attached to Path A.](/assets/images/futures/futures-section-the-two-paths-bw-academic.jpg)
